'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jared LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
